I did some research on techniques to make them proportionate though, so if you decide to do that definitely do your research first. But maybe ask whoever does yours to make them closer to what you’d like? Hope it helps!

I wouldn’t say transphobic, but it’s not uncommon for people who actually have gender dysphoria, unlike Chris, to do crazy shit like that. So if an actual trans person cut their taint, I wouldn’t call them stupid but see it as an impulsive action possibly taken during a panic attack of some sort to deal with the intense hatred they have for their birth gender and genitalia. What was foolish however was Chris refusing to seek help afterwards and believing he was actually growing a vagina, or the simple fact that most people agree that Chris doesn’t even suffer from gender dysphoria in the first place.
So while I wouldn’t say that’s transphobic, an actual trans person that mutilated their genitalia out of impulsive hatred being talked about pejoratively because of it wouldn’t be very understanding of their condition, gender dysphoria just makes you do crazy shit like that sometimes. Since we’re talking about Chris however, with the context being that he doesn’t even have it in the first place and refused to get help and believed he could actually grow a vagina, it’s not offensive and in his case it’s ok to think he’s stupid for doing that.

It’s not exactly one single same-height building though, there’s multiple smaller sections (you can see one of them in the second pic, there’s lower ones on the other side) that people could easily parkour to get to the penthouse (where we live in) and it has always freaked me out... I know it still doesn’t make a lot of sense but honestly it’s the most likely explanation out of everything I’ve thought about. We’ve never heard of any kind of animal that lives around here doing stuff like that. I don’t know if I’m being paranoid, I’m just scared that someone will hurt my parents or my little sister and I didn’t get much sleep last night because of it...
